title: Apagones y control informativo, el caso de Cuba
summary: La crisis energética de 2024 en Cuba intensificó el control informativo del régimen, exacerbando las restricciones a la libertad de expresión y aislando a las comunidades. Los apagones prolongados y las fallas en las telecomunicaciones no solo afectaron la vida cotidiana, sino que también limitaron el acceso a información veraz, dejando a millones de cubanos expuestos a narrativas oficiales y desinformación. En este contexto, los medios independientes enfrentaron enormes desafíos, como el bloqueo de sitios web, restricciones tecnológicas y represalias directas contra periodistas, lo que dificultó la difusión de contenidos informativos dentro de la isla. A pesar de las adversidades, los medios independientes demostraron una notable capacidad de resiliencia mediante estrategias alternativas. Estas iniciativas garantizan el flujo de información y sostienen el vínculo con las audiencias, tanto dentro como fuera del país. En este contexto, las lecciones aprendidas en Cuba —como la diversificación de herramientas tecnológicas, la colaboración con redes locales y el apoyo de la diáspora— ofrecen modelos replicables para enfrentar el control informativo en otros contextos autoritarios, subrayando la importancia de la creatividad, la resistencia y la solidaridad transnacional en la lucha por la libertad de expresión.

title: Derechos humanos, prostitución y evidencia territorial: una crítica al discurso del "trabajo sexual autónomo"
summary: Este artículo analiza críticamente el discurso del "trabajo sexual autónomo" a la luz de la evidencia territorial e investigaciones de campo desarrolladas en Medellín, Colombia. A partir de la caracterización social y cartografía de la explotación sexual realizada por la Fundación Empodérame en 2024, se problematiza la noción de la prostitución como un empleo u opción laboral libre y autónoma. El texto examina cómo la pobreza extrema, la violencia estructural, la migración irregular y el control criminal contradicen los supuestos académicos de "elección real". Asimismo, repasa la postura de la jurisprudencia constitucional colombiana sobre la dignidad humana, desmitifica el enfoque abolicionista feminista demostrando que no es punitivo con las mujeres sino orientado a políticas públicas de salida, y analiza el caso comparado de Alemania para señalar los fracasos del modelo de legalización.

title: Fe en Dios y esperanza de vida en Estados Unidos como estrategias de afrontamiento al trauma del desplazamiento forzado
authors: Clairgue Caizero, Erika N.; Sánchez Arreola, Gala; Soberanis Luna, Marla X.; Ortíz Alavez, Anel
summary: Los cambios recientes en las políticas migratorias y los efectos de la pandemia han convertido a la frontera noroeste de México en un espacio de atrapamiento para familias migrantes jóvenes que huyen de la violencia en México y Centroamérica, muchas de ellas en estados de salud mental deteriorados que pueden agravarse durante el tránsito. Aun así, suelen recurrir a estrategias de afrontamiento basadas en la fe y la esperanza, que les permiten mantener la motivación para continuar. Este estudio, basado en entrevistas a 26 personas refugiadas en albergues de Tijuana y analizadas con Atlas.ti, muestra que las expectativas de seguridad, educación para los hijos, estabilidad política y una vida mejor en Estados Unidos, junto con la figura de Dios, funcionan como anclajes que sostienen la esperanza y reducen el malestar psicológico derivado de experiencias traumáticas previas.

title: Interacciones complejas : conflictos socioambientales, eventos extremos y migración en Centroamérica
summary: El documento analiza la migración en la zona norte de Centroamérica (Guatemala, Honduras y El Salvador) vinculada a conflictos socioambientales y eventos extremos entre 2008 y 2019. A partir de bases de datos como EM-DAT, EJAtlas y la EMIF Sur, se identificaron 161 municipios con contextos adversos y salidas internacionales significativas. Aunque no se establece una relación causal directa, se observa que estos territorios presentan tasas de migración más altas que la media nacional, resultado de la acumulación de factores ambientales, socioeconómicos y políticos. El estudio subraya que la migración no es una reacción inmediata a un evento, sino un proceso multifactorial influido por vulnerabilidades estructurales, desigualdades, falta de políticas públicas y dinámicas locales, y plantea la necesidad de enfoques interdisciplinarios y multiescalares para su análisis.

title: Impacto de la pandemia de covid-19 en el proceso de enseñanza-aprendizaje
summary: En el presente artículo se analizarán diversas publicaciones que nos ayudarán a dimensionar el impacto educativo que se ha generado por la actual pandemia de COVID-19. Las competencias educativas de los docentes y de los alumnos necesitan fortalecerse para generar una educación de mayor calidad en los diferentes escenarios virtuales. Las cifras de estudiantes afectados por falta de elementos para continuar con sus estudios en la modalidad en línea han generado un entorno de rezago y desigualdad que como sociedad y gobierno debemos atender, pero este proceso de asimilar la problemática, vivirla y buscar soluciones no corresponde solo a la figura del docente sino también al alumno el cual debe generar mayores habilidades y compromisos que lo lleven a complementar esta forma de estudios con aprendizaje autónomo. Analizaremos también la transición que hemos tenido de la educación tradicional hacia los entornos virtuales y la necesidad de la adecuación de planes y programas de estudio por parte de nuestras autoridades educativas así como reforzar la capacitación integral de los docentes para impartir clases no solo en el aula física sino también de forma virtual sumergiéndose en el uso de las diferentes herramientas digitales didácticas que 2 existen para que la calidad de la educación tenga los mismos resultados que la modalidad presencial. Este panorama nos hace analizar también que no todas las poblaciones tienen acceso a los servicios y equipos necesarios para la continuidad de sus estudios desde casa y se deben establecer estrategias que favorezcan la creación de planes alternativos que pongan en un panorama de igualdad a toda la comunidad educativa sin distinciones por cuestiones de carácter geográficas o económicas. Este escenario pandémico nos ha hecho crecer como estudiantes y como docentes, pero también nos ha hecho ver nuestras áreas de oportunidad y los esfuerzos de sociedad y gobierno deben ir encaminados al logro y crecimiento para una educación de vanguardia.

title: Inseguridad alimentaria, IMC y síntomas de infección gastrointestinal en mujeres migrantes de un albergue en Tijuana, Baja California
authors: Ruiz-Barba, Ana K.; Rubio-Soto, Ashley M.; Ruiz-Valenzuela, Roxana E.; Dergal-Perea, Michelle
summary: Los migrantes en tránsito que llegan a Tijuana son personas de México y Centroamérica que se instalan en albergues mientras solicitan el asilo en los Estados Unidos. Esto puede tener un impacto en la disponibilidad de alimentos y recursos, lo cual los hace susceptibles a inseguridad alimentaria (IA), alteración del estado nutricional y síntomas de infección gastrointestinal (SIG). Objetivo: Determinar la relación entre el Índice de Masa Corporal (IMC), IA y SIG en una muestra de mujeres migrantes de un albergue de Tijuana. Material y métodos: estudio transversal y analítico. Se aplicó un cuestionario que incluía: percepción de calidad de los alimentos, IA (Food Security Survey Module: Six Item Short Form Economic Research Service, 2012) y SIG en el último mes (Hypothesis Generating Questionnaire for Gastroenteritis Complaint, 1999). Se midió peso (kg) y talla (m) y se obtuvo el IMC (kg/m2). Para el análisis, se aplicó Ji Cuadrado y regresión logística (RM, IC95%) a un nivel de significancia de p ≤ 0.05. Resultados: se incluyeron 96 mujeres procedentes de Honduras (48%), México (25%) y el resto (27%) de El Salvador, Guatemala y Haití (edad: 32 ± 9 años). Se encontró 85% de IA, 62% de sobrepeso y obesidad y 73% de SIG. Se encontró relación entre SIG: diarrea (p = 0.01), dolor estomacal (p = 0.0007), inflamación (p = 0.000), náuseas (p = 0.0007) y mala apariencia de alimentos (p = 0.000) con el nivel de IA, respectivamente. Se encontró asociación entre la IA y el riesgo de presentar mayor frecuencia de SIG, RM 8.3 (IC 95% 2.9-23.8, p = 0.00), no se encontró relación entre IMC con IA o SIG. Conclusiones: existe asociación entre la IA y los SIG, se requieren propuestas de intervención enfocadas a mitigar la vulnerabilidad por acceso a los alimentos y enfermedades infecciosas en migrantes transitorios.

title: Diálogos sobre la intervención y el acompañamiento psicosocial : entre la experiencia de CAMSCUNAD y otros proyectos de mediación institucional
summary: El presente libro nace de la apuesta que tiene la Escuela de Ciencias Sociales, Artes y Humanidades frente a co-construcción de conocimiento acerca de las prácticas y experiencias de trabajo que se vienen desarrollando en el marco de los Centros de Acompañamiento en Salud Mental Comunitaria de la UNAD “CASMCUNAD”. Solo desde el año 2020 en plena pandemia, donde el trabajo articulado de la Maestría en Psicología Comunitaria y el programa de psicología se comienza a promover una estrategia de prácticas desde un modelo de la salud mental comunitaria que permea a los territorios y lograra un impacto real en los procesos de bienestar humano, de ahí que el capítulo 1, Diálogos entorno a las experiencias de intervención psicosocial desde los centros de escucha CASMCUNAD, se logren consolidar 4 trabajos de grado de maestría que hacen referencia a dicho trabajo y como en ellos se realiza grandes aportes no solo desde la práctica sino también a elementos conceptuales como el afrontamiento comunitario, los bienestares (bienestar humano-psicológico y subjetivo), el diagnóstico participativo y en general se apueste a los retos que implican hoy la acción psicosocial en territorio. Por otro lado, el capitulo 2, Experiencias de intervención psicosocial en un diálogo con lo institucional, se da cuenta de 3 experiencias de trabajo comunitario que lograron tener un impacto real en las comunidades y dan cuenta de modelos y acciones innovadoras para el campo psicosocial con diversos actores sociales, una mirada desde la institucionalidad al campo de la investigación/acción comprometida con la transformación social. Finalmente, el capítulo 3, Diálogos y reflexiones en torno a la intervención y el acompañamiento psicosocial, aparecen tres grandes discusiones que se convierten en necesarias a propósito de lo que se viene desarrollando con comunidades con apoyos de la virtualidad, pero además, con las lógicas de lo que significa el acompañamiento vs la intervención y en ese sentido se configura como un escenario propicio para la consolidación de un pensamiento que trascienda la acción psicosocial. En suma, es importante señalar al/la lector/a que, la producción de este libro y los capítulos que lo conforman, nace en medio de una crisis global donde la Psicología Comunitaria requiere de la generación de conocimiento, acompañamiento y acción pertinente y que el trabajo que se viene adelantando en temas de salud mental comunitaria dan avances y rutas claras para trabajarlo, todo ello ha generado retos científicos que demandan fortalecer la formación y divulgación en el campo institucional.

title: Arquitectura Maya VS. Egipcia, análisis estilístico comparativo
authors: Soto Flores, Martha Judith; Jiménez Cuanalo, Jaime Miguel
summary: Desde la segunda mitad del siglo XX, se ha hecho énfasis en aspectos no-arquitectónicos en el análisis de la arquitectura; el contexto socio-histórico, político, económico e ideológico se han explorado al tratar de explicar la arquitectura de diversos lugares y tiempos. Estos factores son importantes; sin embargo, su participación en nuestra experiencia directa de la arquitectura es, en todo caso, indirecta. Este trabajo pretende explorar otra avenida de análisis que no excluye, sino se suma a las anteriores, basada en avances científicos sobre percepción y semiología formal. Se implementa una metodología de análisis y comparación a partir de lo perceptible en la arquitectura, sea que esto se encuentre codificado emotivamente o convencionalmente, de modo que los aspectos arriba mencionados sólo se tomarán en cuenta en la medida en que estén extra-arquitectónicos materialmente codificados en las edificaciones mismas con el objeto de realizar un dictamen estilístico sobre la muestra estudiada. Se analizan aspectos percibidos por los sistemas visuales ‘Dónde’ –visión espacial acromática– y ‘Qué’ –visión figural cromática– además de aspectos del esqueleto estructural del campo perceptual y, finalmente, los elementos convencionales –culturalmente definidos– que resulten relevantes para determinar las tendencias o regularidades presentes en cada muestra, así como las relaciones de parecido y diferencia. El resultado del análisis será la identificación de la tendencia estilística distintiva de cada cultura y está definirá los aspectos estilísticos arquitectónicos, en lo formal, el impacto y contraste de las mismas.

summary: En la actualidad, es fundamental contar con una validación externa que garantice la calidad de los servicios en las instituciones de educación superior (IES). title: Accelerating National Implementation of Sustainable Nitrogen Management: Policy Priorities and Challenges in the Context of the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change
summary: <jats:p>Nitrogen has become increasingly significant within the climate agenda due to its role in linking greenhouse gas mitigation with agriculture, food security, soil and human health, pollution, and biodiversity. The Paris Agreement and the broader United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC) framework offer key opportunities to address the climate-related aspects of nitrogen management. Multiple international commitments seek to halve nitrogen waste or reduce excess nutrient losses by 2030. Nevertheless, nitrogen is frequently addressed in an indirect and inconsistent manner across these initiatives, rather than as a cohesive policy issue. Current evidence indicates that progress remains inadequate to meet the 2030 targets. This policy report synthesizes policy priorities and implementation challenges identified through two workshops and subsequent confidential bilateral discussions with policymakers and technical experts involved in UNFCCC processes. These activities incorporated perspectives from over 40 countries, thereby reflecting a broad spectrum of national experiences and circumstances. A central finding is that international efforts should focus on making existing commitments implementable, rather than pursuing additional commitments. Achieving this objective requires increased attention to the institutional, financial, political, and social factors that influence implementation within countries, while acknowledging that no single approach will be suitable for all national contexts. Across country experiences, five interconnected implementation challenges and priorities emerged: institutional fragmentation; limitations in data, monitoring, measurement, reporting, and verification; political and distributional implications of subsidy reform; financing constraints; and socioeconomic vulnerability, stakeholder engagement, and potential resistance from farmers. The report contends that immediate priority is to accelerate delivery of existing commitments through 2030. At the same time, insufficient progress towards current objectives makes it necessary to consider how international cooperation, peer learning and sustained political attention to nitrogen can continue beyond that date.</jats:p>

title: Tax Productivity and Economic Development: A Quantitative Macroeconomic Analysis
authors: Radhika Goyal; Anders Jensen; David Lagakos; Abdoulaye Ndiaye; Yuntian Zhao
summary: <jats:p>This paper examines the role of government capacity to collect taxes in driving economic development. We first draw on a new macro-historical database to document that tax collections relative to tax administration expenditures rise sharply with GDP per capita. We then interpret this finding in a neoclassical growth model with a tax administration sector in which labor inputs are required to raise tax revenues. Countries differ in their levels of tax productivity, capturing how effectively labor is used to raise taxes, as well as their levels of productivity in creating consumption and investment goods. Governments use tax revenues to provide public capital that complements private factors in production and to make transfers. Quantitatively, our model predicts that increases in tax productivity in low-income economies can raise GDP per capita substantially more than suggested by Hulten’s theorem.</jats:p>

title: The Spillover Effect of Services Offshoring on Local Labour Markets
summary: <jats:p>Between 2000 and 2015, services offshoring has expanded across all sectors, including manufacturing. This paper examines the impact of services offshoring on local employment and wages in the UK. It employs a unique firm-level dataset that tracks offshoring flows at the postcode level, distinguishing between offshoring and non-offshoring firms. By exploiting quasi-random variation in offshoring across local labour markets, it demonstrates that services offshoring leads to increased local employment and wages. This effect arises from productivity gains within offshoring firms and positive spillovers to peers in the same local labour market due to access to cheaper inputs.</jats:p>

title: Spatial distribution and local level integration of migrants in Ireland
authors: Evan Carron-Kee; Daniel Capistrano; Keire Murphy; Lúcás Rohan
summary: <jats:p>While migration is often discussed nationally, it is experienced locally, and migrants integrate into local areas as well as national communities. It is therefore important to understand how migration is spatially distributed, in what kind of communities migrants reside, to what extent migrants are living in segregated areas, and how migration is governed at a local level. All of these factors have implications for both host society acceptance of migration as well as migrant integration. This report studies migrant integration from a spatial perspective. We examine the spatial distribution of migrants in Ireland and contextualise these results with qualitative findings about how this is functioning and being governed at a local level. To structure our analysis, we develop a concept of spatial integration which highlights the role of space in enabling or hindering migrant integration. We carry out a mixed-methods analysis, exploring Census and administrative data and carrying out seven qualitative semi-structured interviews with stakeholders in order to develop insights related to migrant integration in Ireland as well as policy implications.</jats:p>

title: Asymmetric Labor Market Responses to External Demand Fluctuations: Evidence from Latin America
authors: Andres Sebastian Abril Arteaga; León Padilla
summary: <jats:p>This paper examines how external demand fluctuations transmit asymmetrically to labor market outcomes in Latin America a region where structural informality and institutional rigidity shape the margins of employment adjustment. Using a balanced panel of 16 countries from 2001 to 2019, we estimate asymmetric impulse-response functions via local projections with long differences, disaggregating labor market responses by employment category following the ICSE-93 classification. Results reveal a fundamental asymmetry: wage employment does not respond to positive external demand episodes but contracts significantly during negative ones, while self-employment exhibits a countercyclical pattern declining during expansions and expanding as a buffer during downturns. Unemployment plays a minimal role in the adjustment process. Subgroup analyses document substantial heterogeneity within the region: economies with more flexible labor markets and higher trade openness adjust faster and through formal employment margins, while less flexible and more closed economies rely predominantly on self-employment, with more persistent effects. These findings highlight labor market duality and institutional rigidity as the primary conditioners of asymmetric employment adjustment to external demand fluctuations in Latin America, with implications for the design of policies aimed at building more resilient and inclusive labor markets.</jats:p>

title: Caracterización y tipología de sitios de servicios en línea en América Latina y el Caribe
authors: Díaz de Astarloa, Bernardo; de la Cal Medina, Jorge
summary: A pesar de la importancia creciente del comercio de servicios en entornos digitales, su medición es incipiente y enfrenta limitaciones, especialmente en países en desarrollo. Este trabajo busca reducir esta brecha mediante la construcción de una nueva base de datos de más de 2.600 sitios en línea asociados al comercio de servicios en sectores seleccionados en Argentina, Brasil, Chile, Colombia, México y Perú. A partir del análisis de los sitios, se caracterizan sus modelos de negocio y su funcionalidad de acuerdo con un conjunto de atributos que permite entender cómo es la presencia en línea de los distintos sectores y cómo las empresas generan, entregan y capturan valor a través de los sitios. Luego, se aplican técnicas de clusterización para identificar patrones comunes y tipologías de sitios. Finalmente, a partir de datos de tráfico de visitas a cada sitio en cada país, se caracteriza la actividad en línea de los sectores seleccionados, incluyendo un análisis por género y por segmentos de edad. Los resultados sugieren que, desde el punto de vista de la lógica de los modelos de negocios, la semejanza entre sitios no sigue un ordenamiento sectorial, sino que hay una variedad de configuraciones dentro de un mismo sector, con predominancia de sitios que crean valor a través de ventas directas o servicios de intermediación. No se observan diferencias en la caracterización de atributos entre los principales mercados de comercio electrónico de la región. Los resultados pueden aportar elementos para mejorar o refinar el diseño de políticas públicas para fomentar el comercio de servicios a través de canales digitales, incluyendo la capacidad de las empresas para concretar ventas, nacionales o transfronterizas, a través de una presencia en línea.

title: Metodologías para obtener datos sobre empresas exportadoras lideradas por mujeres
summary: Para desarrollar herramientas eficaces de promoción del emprendimiento exportador de las mujeres y medir los avances, es indispensable contar con datos y estudios que permitan caracterizar a las empresas exportadoras lideradas por mujeres. Sin datos adecuados, no es posible diseñar políticas efectivas ni evaluar su impacto real. En América Latina y el Caribe, varios países han generado información específica sobre empresas exportadoras lideradas por mujeres para orientar sus políticas comerciales y contar con herramientas de fomento más específicas. Los estudios desarrollados por estos países utilizan principalmente dos tipos de insumos: a) datos procedentes de registros administrativos de entidades públicas o privadas, y b) resultados de encuestas de empresas. En este documento se presentan los principales aspectos de los análisis realizados por seis países de la región: Brasil, Chile, Costa Rica, Paraguay, Perú y República Dominicana. En todos los casos se identifican datos sobre la participación de las empresas exportadoras lideradas por mujeres a partir de información procedente de registros o encuestas. Los estudios son sólo parcialmente comparables entre sí porque, aun cuando utilizan fuentes similares, seleccionan indicadores y aplican metodologías algo distintas. Conocer la información cuantitativa sobre empresas lideradas por mujeres que exportan, su número, tamaño, ubicación geográfica, montos y productos exportados, principales mercados y continuidad exportadora, es un punto de partida. Para caracterizar plenamente a estas empresas y a las mujeres que las lideran se requiere utilizar también herramientas cualitativas. Para ello se requiere indagar sobre los obstáculos que enfrentan, las barreras de acceso financieras y la discriminación de género. Así como considerar el entorno familiar, la jefatura de hogar, las responsabilidades de cuidados, el trabajo no remunerado, y conocer cómo estas dimensiones —que marcan la vida de las mujeres—, han incidido en su trayectoria profesional y empresarial.

title: Comercio electrónico transfronterizo en América Latina: estrategias y herramientas para las pymes y las empresas lideradas por mujeres
authors: Arteaga, Javiera; Libertelli, Erica; Pueyrredón, Marcos; Trevisan, Pedro
summary: El comercio electrónico ofrece grandes oportunidades para las pequeñas y medianas empresas (pymes) y las empresas lideradas por mujeres que buscan expandir sus mercados más allá de las fronteras nacionales. Eso se debe a que el comercio electrónico transfronterizo representa apenas una quinta parte del total de las transacciones de comercio electrónico en la región. Además, este segmento del electrónico transfronterizo crece a tasas superiores que su contraparte doméstica. Este documento revisa las distintas etapas por las que debe transitar una empresa para acceder al comercio electrónico transfronterizo. Las pymes que incursionan en el comercio electrónico transfronterizo deben superar desafíos en digitalización, financiamiento y conocimiento del mercado de exportación. Las mujeres empresarias enfrentan barreras adicionales como el acceso limitado a financiamiento, redes de apoyo y tecnología, además de la falta de modelos de liderazgo femeninos, lo que dificulta su éxito en este ámbito. Para impulsar el comercio electrónico transfronterizo, es clave usar plataformas (marketplaces) como Amazon, Alibaba o eBay, que facilitan el acceso a mercados internacionales. La transformación digital, que incluye la creación de tiendas en línea y la optimización de la logística y los pagos, es esencial. La capacitación continua y el marketing digital mejoran la visibilidad global, mientras que conocer las preferencias culturales y hábitos de compra del mercado objetivo asegura una estrategia efectiva. Al adoptar estas prácticas, las pymes y negocios liderados por mujeres pueden aumentar sus ventas internacionales, diversificar riesgos y competir en un entorno global en constante digitalización, garantizando así un crecimiento sostenible y exitoso.

title: Perspectivas de desarrollo de las cadenas de valor relacionadas con el litio en Chile y América del Sur
authors: Castillo, Mario; Garcés, Ingrid; Furtado Messias, Rodrigo
summary: Este estudio examina las perspectivas de desarrollo de las cadenas de valor en torno al litio en Chile, destacando la complementariedad con Argentina, Brasil y Bolivia, además de proponer directrices de políticas públicas para fomentar las capacidades regionales en medio al aumento de la demanda de minerales necesarios para la fabricación de tecnologías para la transición energética y la electromovilidad. En el año 2022, se observó un notable incremento en la inversión mundial en la transición energética, abarcando proyectos de energías renovables, electromovilidad y almacenamiento de carbono, lo que generó una demanda global de litio de 690 mil toneladas de Carbonato de Litio Equivalente (LCE). Chile y América del Sur tienen la oportunidad de superar la dicotomía entre una industria basada en recursos no renovables y una sostenible de base tecnológica. Las propuestas de políticas se realizan tomando en consideración el nuevo ciclo tecnológico y las estrategias corporativas asociadas a la transición de la industria automotriz, el desarrollo de energías renovables, la producción de baterías y sus componentes y la extracción de litio de manera más sustentable. Para subsanar la heterogeneidad institucional de los países del triángulo del litio, se plantea una plataforma de colaboración regional organizada sobre tres ejes principales: colaboración tecnológica, colaboración productiva y colaboración financiera. Se proponen tres objetivos estratégicos de cooperación regional: configurar un ecosistema de explotación sustentable de salares; desarrollar capacidades tecnológicas para el diseño y fabricación de baterías de iones de litio para almacenamiento de energía y; promover un mercado regional de electromovilidad para el transporte público. El análisis se enfoca, en primer lugar, en el clúster de exploración, extracción y producción de litio refinado y, en segundo lugar, en el clúster de fabricación de baterías de iones de litio tanto para vehículos eléctricos como para almacenamiento estacionario. Un elemento clave es la visión de desarrollo sostenible que abarca aspectos sociales, ambientales y tecnológicos.

The Panorama of Productive Development Policies in Latin America and the Caribbean, 2025 addresses four themes that were selected for their strategic importance and complementarity: (i) productivity, which is the core structural challenge; (ii) science, technology and innovation, as key drivers of productive transformation; (iii) productive coordination via cluster initiatives and other governance and collaboration mechanisms, which is essential for mobilizing key actors and multiplying impacts; and (iv) environmental sustainability and social inclusion based on green and inclusive productive development policies, these being principles that should guide the best version of this transformation. Together, these themes form a road map for progress towards higher, sustained, inclusive and sustainable growth that can also accelerate the achievement of the Sustainable Development Goals.

title: Effects of the recent hostilities in and around the Islamic Republic of Iran on Latin America and the Caribbean
summary: The coronavirus disease (COVID-19) pandemic that broke out in 2020 and the conflict between the Russian Federation and Ukraine that erupted in 2022 have demonstrated how the effects of initially localized events can quickly propagate and impact production, supply chains, prices, financial conditions and growth prospects in today’s highly interdependent world. The recent hostilities involving the United States and Israel, on one side, and the Islamic Republic of Iran, on the other, that began on 28 February 2026 provide yet another example of just how interdependent the world economy is and how swiftly disruptions and shocks spread across countries and regions. There are many different channels of transmission: trade, logistics and global value chains, prices and inflation, fiscal accounts, monetary and financial conditions, and global economic growth dynamics. Shocks do not flow through these channels at a uniform pace, however. Their impact depends on the international position of each economy, its production structure and its trade and financial links with the rest of the world. This report starts out by providing an analysis of what impacts the recent hostilities have had at the global level and will then go on to explore their specific implications for Latin America and the Caribbean.

title: A New Source of Eighteenth-Century Devonshire Dialect Literature: Evidence From ‘A Dialogue About The Hairy Man’ (C.1785) — ES: Una nueva fuente de literatura de Devonshire de 18 años: evidencia de un diálogo sobre el hombre peludo (C.1785)
summary: This paper analyses the language employed in ‘A Dialogue about the Hairy Man’, an anonymous obscure text published in a newspaper in 1785, as a new source of dialectal information in Devonshire. In doing so, it seeks to contribute to the ongoing research on the analysis of dialect writing in the literature of the eighteenth century. Thus, I examine and quantify all respellings that could point at non-standard language developments in terms of phonology, while also identifying morphological and lexical items that could have been documented at later dates before the consideration of this text. I expect to provide an early exposition of dialectal forms inscribed in the linguistic repertoire of Devonshire during a period where information is scarce and fragmentary. The fact that the forms documented by antiquarians during the nineteenth century are already found here could broaden our knowledge with regards to their history and resilience throughout time.

title: Retos y oportunidades de gestión de suministro y disponibilidad de medicamentos en establecimientos de salud en latinoamérica: Una revisión literaria
authors: Lozada Ucancial, César; Heredia Llatas, Flor Delicia
summary: La presente revisión literaria analiza los retos y oportunidades de la gestión del suministro y la disponibilidad de medicamentos en establecimientos de salud de Latinoamérica. El estudio parte del reconocimiento de que el acceso oportuno a medicamentos esenciales continúa siendo una problemática relevante para los sistemas sanitarios, especialmente en contextos marcados por desigualdades territoriales, restricciones presupuestarias, fragmentación logística y limitada capacidad de respuesta ante situaciones de desabastecimiento. Metodológicamente, se desarrolló una revisión cualitativa de literatura científica, orientada por la estrategia PICO y lineamientos PRISMA, considerando investigaciones publicadas en bases de datos de alto impacto como Scopus, ScienceDirect y SciELO. Los hallazgos evidencian que los principales desafíos se relacionan con deficiencias en la planificación de la demanda, debilidades en la gestión de inventarios, escasez de personal especializado, procesos de adquisición poco transparentes, limitada trazabilidad y dependencia de proveedores externos. No obstante, también se identifican oportunidades significativas, como la implementación de plataformas digitales, sistemas de monitoreo en tiempo real, tecnologías de trazabilidad, fortalecimiento de la producción local, compras centralizadas, capacitación del personal farmacéutico y creación de inventarios estratégicos. En conclusión, mejorar la gestión del suministro de medicamentos requiere políticas públicas integrales, innovación tecnológica, cooperación interinstitucional y mecanismos de control que permitan garantizar una disponibilidad continua, equitativa y segura de medicamentos esenciales en los establecimientos de salud latinoamericanos

authors: Parra Morocho, David Alejandro; Anaya Eulogio, Rodrigo; Izquierdo Limón, Jorge Arturo; Reyes Cevallos, Julia Inés; Villacreses Portero, María José; Proaño Cornejo, Valentina Doménica; Zambrano Flores, Diego Paúl
summary: Patellofemoral arthroplasty (PFA) with second-generation onlay implants has become a reliable treatment option for isolated patellofemoral osteoarthritis; however, optimization of long-term outcomes and surgical decision-making continues to be an area of ongoing investigation. This retrospective cohort study included 231 patients who underwent PFA with a minimum follow-up of 5 years (mean: 8 years). Postoperative functional outcomes were assessed using the Kujala, IKDC, and WOMAC scores, while implant survivorship was evaluated using Kaplan–Meier curves. In addition, multivariate regression analysis was performed to identify prognostic factors associated with long-term outcomes. A mathematical model based on game theory and Nash equilibrium was also developed, incorporating clinical outcomes, revision rates, and cost-effectiveness variables. The results demonstrated significant functional improvement, with a 90.9% reduction in pain and sustained recovery for up to 14 years. The main predictors identified were rehabilitation adherence and patient age at the time of surgical intervention.

title: Formas y niveles de violencia de pareja en mujeres rurales de Cañaveral (Pedernales, Manabí)
authors: Cedeño Gómez, Angie Pamela; Zambrano Marcillo, María Valentina
summary: The present study delves into the forms and levels of intimate partner violence against women in rural areas, focusing on the community of “Cañaveral” in the Pedernales canton of the Manabí province, Ecuador. The objective is to explore these manifestations and provide a deeper understanding of this phenomenon in order to contribute to the implementation of effective intervention strategies. To this end, a mixed-method approach was adopted, with a non-experimental, cross-sectional design and a sample consisting of 65 women over the age of 18, using the Dating Violence Questionnaire and a sociodemographic survey. The results revealed a high incidence of different types of intimate partner violence directed against the women in the study, with physical violence being the most prevalent (60%), followed by economic (22%), psychological (15%), and sexual (21%) violence. These forms of violence are sustained by factors such as economic dependence (55%) and fear of retaliation (21%). These findings indicate that this issue should be considered a critical public health and social concern, exacerbated by conditions that expose victims to multiple forms of vulnerability, emphasizing the need for comprehensive and culturally appropriate interventions that address structural factors and provide emotional, social, and economic support to the victims

title: Integración de la inteligencia artificial en la enseñanza de las matemáticas para la resolución de problemas y el pensamiento lógico
authors: Trávez Angueta, Jorge Raúl; Chicaiza Lema, Wilmer Vidal; Palate Martínez, Mayra Alexandra; Escobar López, José Amable
summary: The present study analyses the effect of integrating Artificial Intelligence tools into mathematics teaching on problem-solving performance and logical thinking among upper basic level students from public educational units within Zonal Coordination 3 of Ecuador, encompassing the provinces of Tungurahua, Cotopaxi, Chimborazo, and Pastaza. A descriptive quantitative design was employed with a sample of 136 students from eighth, ninth, and tenth year of general basic education, distributed across four parallel classroom groups in institutions located in Ambato and Latacunga. Instruments comprised a 40-item mathematical problem-solving test, an analytical reasoning assessment, and a 100-point logical thinking scale administered at three intervals. Results showed that mathematical problem-solving improved by 56.1% relative to baseline, with an effect size of Cohen's d = 2.31. Analytical comprehension increased by 57.1%, whilst the logical thinking index rose by 75.8% across ten weeks of implementation, with a partial eta-squared of 0.618. These findings confirm that artificial intelligence constitutes an effective, adaptive, and scalable pedagogical resource for improving mathematical performance and cognitive development among students in the Ecuadorian educational context.

title: Mitos y realidades sobre el papel del psicopedagogo en el Trastorno del Espectro Autista
authors: Carrillo Freire, Shirley Tatiana; Ponluisa Azogue, Milton Alexander; Naranjo Pico, David Miguel; Andrade Chamorro, Christian Andrés
summary: Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD) requires educational support grounded in interdisciplinary work, in which the school psychopedagogue performs functions that go beyond punctual academic support. However, myths persist in the literature that reduce this role to writing reports or curricular adaptations, obscuring the professional's contribution to assessment, strategy design, and follow-up of the educational process. This mixed-methods, non-experimental, cross-sectional study aimed to analyze the perceptions of psychopedagogy professionals in Ecuador regarding the myths and realities associated with their role in supporting students with ASD. An 18-item online questionnaire (14 closed Likert-type items and 4 open-ended questions) was administered to a final sample of 230 professionals, selected through intentional non-probabilistic sampling. Results showed a majority rejection of the three myths assessed: restricting intervention to academic difficulties, limiting the role to report writing without follow-up, and assuming that continuous training is unnecessary for effective practice. These findings indicate that, from the profession's own perspective, there is a clear recognition of the psychopedagogue's competencies in supporting students with ASD. However, the absence of teachers', administrators', and families' perspectives limits the generalizability of these results and points to the need for future research contrasting these perceptions with those of other educational stakeholders.

summary: This study examines the incidence of paper theater, used as a pedagogical resource integrated with mathematical problem-solving, on the strengthening of reading comprehension and logical thinking among basic education students from schools in the Ecuadorian highlands. authors: Valente Cepeda, Luis Arturo; Chicaiza Toalombo, Paúl Vinicio; Terán Guato, Ana Rocío; Cayambe De La Cruz, Vilma Lucrecia
summary: This study examines the influence of artificial intelligence (AI) use on the curricular planning processes of General Basic Education teachers in public institutions of the Ecuadorian highlands (sierra). title: La depresión como factor determinante en la adherencia al tratamiento de hemodiálisis.
authors: Pilligua Lucas, Jennifer Estefanía; Sornoza Zavala, Gioryi Augusto
summary: Depression is a common condition among patients who begin hemodialysis treatment, and it has been linked to lower treatment adherence and poorer health outcomes. For this reason, the idea arose to conduct a descriptive-correlational cross-sectional study aimed at evaluating the relationship between depression and adherence to hemodialysis treatment at the Buena Vista Renal Clinic in the city of Manta, using a sample of 68 patients who were starting renal replacement therapy. Two instruments were used: the self-administered Zung scale to measure depression levels, and the MBG Therapeutic Adherence Questionnaire (developed by Martín, Bayarre, and Grau) to assess treatment adherence.The results revealed that newly admitted patients presented moderate levels of depression. Despite the prevalence of depressive symptoms, most patients showed good overall adherence to hemodialysis treatment. These findings suggest that, although depression is an important factor that can influence treatment adherence, it does not necessarily translate into low adherence or complete abandonment of renal treatment in all cases studied. It is possible that other factors, such as family support and socioeconomic conditions, play an important role in the adherence process. Therefore, it is recommended to consider these additional aspects when evaluating and developing strategies to improve treatment adherence in patients with depression.

summary: Professional identities are constructed and reconstructed, in a dynamic process of the teacher's interaction with the context and the relationships that are established with others and with the world, as well as their internal and significant issues. summary: This study aims to identify and analyze how data management is addressed in the scientific literature in the context of digital objects, considering models, practices, and applications in information and technological environments. The sample was 203 doctoral advisors in education who worked between 2020 and 2022. Production in the Scopus database and the Google Scholar search engine was considered. The results indicate that national universities are those with the lowest publication averages of their advisors. The university with the best impact index (h) of its advisors is the Pontificia Universidad Católica del Perú (PUCP). summary: The intention to drop out among first-year university students is a critical issue that can be influenced by various psychological and academic factors. title: Salvador de Madariaga: economicismo, carácter nacional y corporativismo
authors: Perdices de Blas, Luis; Ramos Gorostiza, José Luis
summary: Salvador de Madariaga (1886-1978) was a multifaceted intellectual of the Silver Age with a notable international profile. Like other liberals of this period —such as Marañón and Ortega— his knowledge of economics was very limited. Although his education would have allowed him to understand the new currents of economic thought, he attached much greater importance to spiritual factors than to material ones and was always highly critical of what he called «economism». Precisely because of the characteristics of the national character, he considered that a comprehensive corporate model was the only viable option for Spain in the 1930s: politically, as opposed to classical parliamentarianism, it would allow for greater representativeness, stability, and decentralization; economically, far removed from both American capitalism and Soviet communism, it would free the technical management of economic affairs from political interference and particular interests. Curiously, he maintained his corporatist stance until the end of his life, considering it a third way that was compatible with liberal ideology. However, this work concludes that economic liberalism and integral corporatism are incompatible, after comparing Madariaga’s «liberal» corporate proposal with Eduardo Aunós’s «anti-liberal» corporate proposal from the same period in practical economic terms.

title: La teoría política del fascismo en Nicos Poulantzas: aportes, límites y debates contemporáneos
summary: This article offers a critical reassessment of Nicos Poulantzas’s theory of fascism as developed in Fascism and Dictatorship: The Third International and the Problem of Fascism (1970), situating it within contemporary debates on the relationship between social structures, state dynamics, ideology, and political mobilization. It argues that Poulantzas’s most significant contribution lies not only in his interpretation of historical fascism, but also in his early formulation of the problem of the relative autonomy of the political sphere against the economic reductionism and instrumentalist approaches that dominated much Marxist thought at the time. Through a reconstruction of his main analytical categories, the article examines both the strengths and limitations of his framework. It contends that, despite breaking with economic determinism, Poulantzas’s theory tends to subsume the dynamics of fascism within a relatively unified functional logic, thereby limiting its capacity to account for the contingent interaction between class relations, state actors, political cultures, ideological processes, and concrete historical experiences. Engaging critically with authors such as Fraenkel, Broszat, Mann, Hall, Traverso, Jessop, Mosse, Griffin, Gentile, and Costa Pinto, the article shows how subsequent historiographical developments have enriched the study of fascism by incorporating institutional, cultural, symbolic, and geopolitical dimensions. It concludes that Poulantzas’s work retains considerable theoretical relevance, not as a comprehensive explanation of fascism, but as a key intervention in the debate over the articulation of structure, agency, and political autonomy.

title: La protección de la movilidad climática en el Sistema Interamericano de Derechos Humanos: aportes y desafíos de la Opinión Consultiva OC-32/25
summary: Advisory Opinion OC-32/25 of the Inter-American Court of Human Rights marks a milestone in the legal recognition of climate-induced human mobility. The Court affirms that displacement—internal, cross-border, planned or arising from involuntary immobility—is a direct and indirect consequence of the climate crisis and therefore generates specific state obligations of prevention, protection, and reparation. Among its most notable contributions is the consolidation of a human-rights-based approach requiring heightened due diligence, safeguards against evictions and relocations, and cross-border protection mechanisms such as humanitarian visas and temporary residence permits. However, the Opinion also leaves key questions unresolved: it does not define thresholds to trigger climate-related non-refoulement, fails to articulate criteria for refugee recognition, and provides limited operational guidance for implementation. OC-32/25 inaugurates an ambitious normative framework for climate mobility, yet its transformative impact will depend on state compliance and the development of stronger regional legal and policy mechanisms moving forward.

summary: This paper examines the constitutionalisation of the right of self-determination in Quebec's draft constitution (the Loi constitutionnelle de 2025 sur le Québec, currently before the National Assembly) and sets it against the evolution of the Catalan conflict from STC 31/2010 to the Constitutional Court's rulings of 2017. authors: Bonet Martí, Jordi; Roig Roca, Aina; Ubasart González, Gemma
summary: This article analyzes the role of non-statewide parties (PANE) in Balearic politics during four decades of democratic self-government (1983-2023). Through historical-institutional analysis and systematization of electoral and governmental data on four formations (Unió Mallorquina, Proposta per les Illes, Partit Socialista de Mallorca, and MÉS per Mallorca), the article documents a central paradox: despite their modest electoral size (never exceeding 15 % individually or 22 % collectively), the PANE have exerted decisive influence on governance, participating in regional government for 27 of 40 years and controlling the presidency of the Consell de Mallorca for 16 years. title: Urban sprawl prediction in Batna City, Eastern Algeria, Using the SLEUTH model — ES: Predicción de esguince urbano en la ciudad de Batna, Argelia oriental, utilizando el modelo SLEUTH
authors: Hersous, Khaled; Souiher, Nouari; Farouk, Mezali; Aguejdad, Rahim
summary: As a developing country, Algeria has experienced urban extensions, often poorly managed, which have generated numerous social, urban, and economic problems. In this context, this work aims to present an integrated approach combining spatial modeling, geographic remote sensing, and geographic information system to plan sustainable urban growth and mitigate the aforementioned issues. This work introduces urban sprawl simulation using the SLEUTH model, based on the cellular automata method. SLEUTH, implemented with a open-source code, facilates the simulation and prediction of urban sprawl. Applied to the Batna metropolitan area, SLEUTH is calibrated using four chronological series of data extracted from satellite images spanning from 1986 to 2020, with approximately 2,000 hectares transformed into urban land, representing an increase of about 180%. Future scenarios simulations were conducted for a 50-year period up to 2072, revealing two growth stages of urbanized areas. Beyond 2048, population density experiences a constant increase, marking the point at which Batna city reaches its urbanization limits. These findings highlight the necessity for urban planners to prepare an appropriate urban policy within a suitable timeframe. The integration of the SLEUTH model into the decision-making process is recommended to enhance urban policy management.

Más allá de 2048, la densidad de población experimenta un aumento constante, marcando el punto en que la ciudad de Batna alcanza sus límites de urbanización. Estas conclusiones ponen de relieve la necesidad de que los planificadores urbanos preparen una política urbana adecuada dentro de un plazo adecuado. Se recomienda la integración del modelo SLEUTH en el proceso de adopción de decisiones para mejorar la gestión de políticas urbanas.

Se realizaron simulaciones de escenarios futuros durante un período de 50 años hasta 2072, revelando dos etapas de crecimiento de las zonas urbanizadas. Más allá de 2048, la densidad de población experimenta un aumento constante, marcando el punto en que la ciudad de Batna alcanza sus límites de urbanización. Estas conclusiones ponen de relieve la necesidad de que los planificadores urbanos preparen una política urbana adecuada dentro de un plazo adecuado. Se recomienda la integración del modelo SLEUTH en el proceso de adopción de decisiones para mejorar la gestión de políticas urbanas.

title: Discapacidad visual y multisensorialidad. Caminando en Lima

summary: We ask about the logic behind the residential trajectories of migrant population and their effect in the composition of their social bonds. title: Transmisión transgeneracional del trauma en contextos de violencia política: una mirada al contexto español con perspectiva de género
summary: This theoretical review examines the transgenerational transmission of trauma in contexts of political violence, focusing on Spain after the Civil War and the Franco dictatorship. The aim is to integrate biological, psychological, and psychosocial approaches to transgenerational trauma and to analyze their relevance for understanding its effects in the Spanish context from a gender perspective. Contributions from epigenetics, psychoanalytic theory, and narrative and community-based approaches are reviewed, highlighting both their contributions and limitations in explaining intergenerational transmission processes. The analysis addresses common expressions of transgenerational trauma –such as family silences, unresolved grief, and implicit mandates– and explores their manifestation in a historical context marked by prolonged sociopolitical repression and social silencing. An integrative framework is proposed that articulates existing models with a narrative approach to experience and historical memory in order to broaden the understanding of trauma and its consequences for individual and community mental health.

title: El síndrome de Cassandra: clínica del saber desautorizado en el vínculo familiar
summary: This paper proposes a clinical conceptualization of the so‑called “Cassandra syndrome,” understood as a subjective experience in which lucid knowledge -especially among mental health professionals and emotionally perceptive individuals- is systematically disauthorized within significant relationships, particularly in family contexts. Drawing on the Greek myth of Cassandra and its symbolic reinterpretation, the phenomenon is articulated through a psychodynamic, phenomenological, and relational lens, in dialogue with the notions of ethical recognition (Ricoeur, 1990), ontological presence (Marcel, 1951), existential meaning of suffering (Frankl, 1946), false self (Winnicott, 1965), and relational trauma (Ferenczi, 1999). It is argued that this syndrome does not constitute an individual pathology but rather a structural emergent of contexts in which emotional truth becomes affectively intolerable. Finally, clinical guidelines are offered that emphasize the validation of silenced knowledge, its narrative symbolization, and the restoration of subjective desire beyond external recognition.

Resultados: La estrategia presenta un carácter predominantemente declarativo, con ausencia de estimaciones de necesidades, objetivos cuantificados y definición operativa de recursos. Conclusiones: La estrategia constituye un marco conceptual relevante, pero presenta limitaciones estructurales que dificultan su capacidad transformadora. summary: Aim of study: To develop a real-time detection system for grape leaf blister mite (Eriophyes vitis (Pagst.)), a significant pest in vineyards, using deep learning models. Early detection of pests and diseases is essential to mitigate agricultural losses, especially considering challenges such as climate change, shrinking agricultural areas, and increasing food demand. Area of study: The study was conducted in vineyard areas located in Tokat, Türkiye, a region known for its extensive viticulture. Material and methods: An Arduino Tiny ML kit and the Edge Impulse platform were utilized to deploy the FOMO (Faster Objects, More Objects) MobileNetV2 0.1 model. The model was trained using a custom dataset of grape leaf blister mite images and validated against expert observations. Real-time detection of blister counts caused by E. vitis was evaluated through comparative metrics. Main results: The trained model achieved a classification success of 90% with an F1 score on the validation dataset and an accuracy of 96.25% on the test dataset. Blister numbers were assessed using both expert observations and the real-time detection system, resulting in RMSE (Root Mean Squared Error) of 1.862 and a MAPE (Mean Absolute Percentage Error) of 15.63%. These results demonstrate the system’s reliability in detecting vineyard pests with high precision. Conclusions: The proposed system provides a practical, cost-effective, and accurate approach for pest detection in vineyards, offering significant potential to enhance pest management strategies and reduce economic losses in agriculture.

source_summary_es: Objetivo de estudio: Desarrollar un sistema de detección en tiempo real para el ácaro de hoja de uva (Eriophyes vitis (Pagst.)), una plaga significativa en viñedos, utilizando modelos de aprendizaje profundo. La detección temprana de plagas y enfermedades es esencial para mitigar las pérdidas agrícolas, especialmente considerando retos como el cambio climático, la reducción de las zonas agrícolas y el aumento de la demanda de alimentos. Área de estudio: El estudio se realizó en zonas viñas ubicadas en Tokat, Türkiye, una región conocida por su amplia viticultura. Material y métodos: Un kit Arduino Tiny ML y la plataforma Edge Impulse fueron utilizados para desplegar el modelo FOMO (Objetos rápidos, más objetos) MobileNetV2 0.1. El modelo fue entrenado utilizando un conjunto de datos personalizado de imágenes de ácaro de hoja de uva y validado contra observaciones expertas. Se evaluó la detección en tiempo real de los recuentos de ampollas causados por E. vitis mediante métricas comparativas. Principales resultados: El modelo entrenado logró un éxito de clasificación del 90% con una puntuación F1 en el conjunto de datos de validación y una precisión del 96,25% en el conjunto de datos de prueba. Los números de Blister se evaluaron utilizando tanto las observaciones de expertos como el sistema de detección en tiempo real, lo que dio lugar a un error de RMSE (Root Mean Squared Error) de 1.862 y un MAPE (Mean Absolute Error) de 15.63%. Estos resultados demuestran la fiabilidad del sistema en la detección de plagas de viñedos con alta precisión. Conclusiones: El sistema propuesto ofrece un enfoque práctico, eficaz en función de los costos y preciso para la detección de plagas en los viñedos, que ofrece un potencial significativo para mejorar las estrategias de gestión de plagas y reducir las pérdidas económicas en la agricultura.

title: Fernando Gilleman: autoridad intelectual y censura en la España ilustrada
summary: Fernando Gilleman stands as an example of discreet intellectual authority with-in the Bourbon administration of the late eighteenth century. His incorporation into the institutional sphere from 1786 onwards reveals a process of legitimation grounded in linguistic competence, archival expertise, and the adoption of the Enlightened ideal of public service. Analysis of his work as translator, censor, and mediator between knowl-edge and normative frameworks sheds light on the silent dynamics of intellectual author-ity operating within the Bourbon apparatus. His trajectory invites a reassessment of the centrality of discreet actors who, through technical precision and indirect intervention, contributed both to the circulation of knowledge and to the ideological consolidation of the Enlightened state

title: La Real Academia de la Historia y la censura de la prensa (1776-1791)
summary: This article examines the role of the Real Academia de la Historia (RAH) in the censorship of the Spanish press between 1776 and 1791, focusing on the administrative mechanisms and the evolution of censorial procedures before and after the Royal Order of 19 May 1785. Drawing on eight surviving files held by the RAH, the study reconstructs the criteria, tensions, and practices that shaped the evaluation of newspaper prospectuses and early issues, as well as the institution’s involvement in granting printing licenses. The analysis shows how the Academy became a central actor within the Enlightenment censorship system, issuing detailed reports that addressed both traditional doctrinal con-cerns and the emerging demands of the periodical genre

title: José Antonio Banqueri, censor
summary: José Antonio Banqueri (1745-1818) is best known for his academic work as an Arabist, which he carried out at both the Royal Library and the Royal Academy of History. Less well known, however, is his work as a censor, which he carried out mainly in connection with this institution, first as a correspondent and later as a permanent member. A manuscript that has never been studied before, preserved in the library of the Feijoo Institute of 18th-Century Studies, provides a privileged perspective for analysing his work as a censor, including possible drafts of some of his censorship decisions, as well as others unknown to historiography to date

title: Permiso para elogiar: las solicitudes de dedicatoria a María Luisa de Parma (1765-1808)
summary: This article proposes a study of the dedications to Marie-Louise of Parme as Princess of Asturias (1765-1788) and Queen Consort of Spain (1788-1808). The funda-mental pillar of this work will be the requirement to request permission from the Secretary of State in order to address a text to a member of the royal family. In this way, the ac-cepted dedications tell us about the topics and authors who were allowed to be associated with the first woman of the kingdom, while the reasons given for rejecting a laudatory text, which complete the image of the queen transmited by the printer. Therefore, the combina-tion of the paratexts finally published with the files of dedication requests will allow us to understand the image of Marie-Louise of Parme shaped by literary figures, inevitably at the service of the Crown’s wishes, involved in its own representation. Likewise, we pres-ent a systematisation of the archival information on all the works dedicated or rejected that it has been possible to locate

title: Vicisitudes editoriales de las Obras poéticas de Ana de San Jerónimo: la censura previa a la impresión
summary: Ana de San Jerónimo’s Obras poéticas (1696–1771) were published posthumous-ly in 1773. This article examines the documentation related to obtaining the printing license, which has been partially located (Archivo Histórico Nacional, Real Academia Española). Such documentation reveals important details of the editorial process, such as its beginning during the author’s lifetime, the delays that allowed additional poems to be incorporated into the collection originally submitted, and the intervention of censor-ship. Particularly significant are the two reports issued. The information they contain, together with support from another manuscript collection, makes it possible to analyze the censored words and verses, the reasons given by the censors —mostly religious and linguistic— and the effects on the affected compositions

title: Contra el indiscreto celo de reformar: la publicación fallida de Lo que hay de más y de menos en España, de José del Campillo, 1786-1795
summary: This study reconstructs, from previously unknown archival materials, the at-tempt to publish the book Lo que hay de más y de menos en España, by José del Campillo, whose license in the Council of Castile was unsuccessfully sought, through various chan-nels, on three separate occasions. The work was censored by a large and distinguished list of censors from the Madrid Society, the Academy of History, the Vicariate of Madrid, and others acting in their individual capacities, and was denounced to the Secretary of State. The fact that, for similar or different reasons, so many censorship reports from various institutions over almost ten years were unanimous in deeming the work unpublishable for political reasons illustrates the systematic and consensual manner in which the State differentiated what could be freely discussed in the public sphere from what could not, as well as the effectiveness of the system

title: El Duende sevillano (1770): estudio y edición de un periódico prohibido por la censura
summary: El Duende sevillano was a journal project conceived by the printer Manuel Martín in 1770, whose license for publication was denied by the Council of Castile. Signed by Abate Palmini, this weekly follows the model of satirical-moral press of the late eight-eenth century, offering a humorous critique of social customs. Its only issue, preserved in the Archivo Histórico Nacional, portrays a burlesque literary mask and a deliberately popular style that draws on oral formulas and the intentional use of seseo to construct a fictional Sevillian voice. This study presents the critical edition of the unpublished text, along with an analysis of its rhetorical strategies and the reasons behind its prohibition

title: ¿Marchena ante la censura? Notas sobre el caso de La escuela de las mujeres en 1816
summary: This study presents the gloss and analysis of the unpublished censorship file concerning the 1816 performance of La escuela de las mujeres, preserved in file 4485/21 of the Inquisition section at the Archivo Histórico Nacional. It examines José Marche-na’s translation of Molière’s play. The approach involves reconstructing the sociopolitical context of the absolutist six-year period and its antecedents, in which the liberal cultural project and the conservative reaction confront one another. The study includes a partial transcription of passages from the document and references to archival elements that reaffirm Marchena’s authorship, together with an analysis of the agents involved, the the-atrical conception of the period, and the role of the Inquisition in these processes. This set of elements, combined with an examination of the evaluators’ enunciation, makes it possible to identify the explicit and implicit causes of the censorship, linked both to po-litical and ideological consideration

title: Una comedia prohibida en busca de autor: La madrastra (1788)
summary: This article reveals an unpublished inquisitorial file from the National Historical Archive referring to the prohibition of La madrastra, an anonymous play from the late 18th century. title: Fe, ciencia y ficción en las Sizigias de Manuel Rivas en el Yucatán del siglo XVIII
summary: Lunar Syzygies and Quadratures Adjusted to the Meridian of Mérida, Yucatán, by an Anctitone or Inhabitant of the Moon is a short story written by Franciscan friar, Manuel Antonio Rivas, in 18th century Yucatán, who was denounced to the Inquisition. In this article, I analyze how the short story combines faith, science, and fiction to imagine new cultural pathways. I also focus on its inquisitorial censorship because it shows two operat-ing models: a traditional one which seeks to confirm heretical claims, and another which aims to differentiate faith from fiction —thus offering a type of enlightened inquisitorial censorship

title: Proposiciones malsonantes y calificaciones insidiosas: Peralta Barnuevo ante la censura inquisitorial
summary: The Lima intellectual Pedro de Peralta Barnuevo maintained a complex rela-tionship with the viceregal authorities and the Holy Office, of which he was a consultor. In 1733, he published the account of the auto-da-fé commissioned by Viceroy Castelfuerte, facing accusations of offensive propositions. The viceroy protected him, and the text was published despite inquisitorial objections. In 1736, he wrote the Relación de gobierno of the Viceroy, considered a model of the genre, in which he defended the Royal Patronage and criticized ecclesiastical power, further straining his relationship with the Inquisition. In 1738, he published Pasión y Triunfo de Cristo, with all the required licenses and approvals, including that of his brother, a bishop. Inquisitor Calderón accused him of blasphemous and heretical propositions and of not being a theologian. Gravely ill, Peralta defended himself with the «Satisfacción de las dos proposiciones». After two years of proceedings, the charges did not prevail, although the book was expurgated fifty years later. I propose to analyze these encounters between Peralta and the Holy Office, as well as the censures and trials to which he was subjected

title: Carta de una escritora a su pupila: ejemplaridad y sátira en Las literatas de Rosalía de Castro
summary: This article studies Rosalía de Castro’s Las literatas as a satirical representation of the expectations that society held regarding educated women in the second half of the 19th century. It also examines this piece as an example of the essay genre encompassing the var-ious historical dissertations written on the social condition and freedom of women. First, the article analyzes the text’s originality in relation to the popular genre of «letters of advice for women», a type of writing very common in the press of the 18th and 19th centuries. Subse-quently, it studies Rosalía de Castro’s burlesque portrayal of the literary social scene of her time through her rewriting of the stereotypical models of learned women or writers already found in newspapers and various literary works that addressed the «woman question»

title: Siglos de oro y siglos de hierro. Apogeo y decadencia de la literatura española en la narrativa historiográfica de la prensa periódica decimonónica (1828-1848)
summary: The article examines how the Philosophy of History shaped a narrative of the rise and fall of national literature, which was most widely disseminated in the 1830s and 1840s through the press. This narrative model, indebted to German and French frame-works, enabled the articulation of a causal literary historiography that linked medieval origins, Golden Age splendour and subsequent crisis, turning literature into a decisive marker of liberal identity. Through authors such as Böhl de Faber, Lista, Larra, Gil y Car-rasco, Fermín Gonzalo Morón and José Joaquín de Mora, the article analyses the mecha-nisms of appropriation of the past, the centrality of Christianity, the role of sentiment as a hermeneutic criterion and the legitimising function of historical genealogies

title: La patria en verso: imaginarios nacionales en la prensa decimonónica. Sentido e intrahistoria de una oda a Isabel II (1845) de Juan María Capitán
summary: This article presents the analysis and critical edition of a poem dedicated to Queen Isabel ii, written by Juan María Capitán in the aftermath of the conspiratorial and insurrectional events of 1844 and published in Revista Literaria de El Español in Septem-ber 1845. Through this specific case, the study illustrates the role of nineteenth-century literary journalism in shaping the royal imaginary of clemency and concord during a period marked by the young queen`s need for political legitimization. The manuscript sources preserved in the Fernández-Guerra Family Archive enable a dialogue between the author’s public and private facets, offering valuable insight into his ideological posi-tioning and the motivations underlying his literary production

title: Imágenes de mujeres eróticas como estrategia editorial y de crítica socio-moral en los almanaques del siglo XIX: imaginarios gráficos de Manuel Cubas en almanaque cómico y almanaque diabólico
summary: This article examines the text-visual scenes by the novelist and satirical car-toonist Manuel Cubas, published in two 19th-century Spanish almanacs: the Almanaque cómico (1873) and the Almanaque diabólico (1877-1879), both aimed at a male read-ership. It also explains the socio-moral critique that these scenes conveyed regarding the corrupt Catholic-bourgeois reality of the time, affected by the nascent struggle for women’s emancipation and the double stan-dards of the bourgeoisie

title: Nuevas repúblicas y nueva España. Testimonio de una revolución en la prensa hispanoamericana de la primera mitad del siglo XIX
summary: This study presents an analysis of the revolutionary events that had led to both the successive American liberation movements and the impressions that had reached America of the aesthetic and political revolution of the young Spanish romantics. The creation of a new ideological and aesthetic features of the new American republics revived the memory of a young Spain hostile to the Ancien Régime, and not only embraced liberalism as a sign of progress but also romanticism as an aesthetic movement. title: La politización del idilio campestre: la poesía de Lazare Carnot (1753-1823)
summary: Lazare Carnot (1753-1823), the «Organizer of Victory», was not only one of the most important figures of the French Revolution, but also the author of a considerable number of poems compiled in Opuscules poétiques du general L.-N.-M. Carnot(1820). However, his poetry has received little attention from scholars, likely due to its clas-sicizing tendency and, more importantly, its apparent disconnection with the politics of the time. This paper aims to refute this interpretation, showing instead that his poems articulate a vision of the country very similar to the one that the physiocrats defended and a conception of happiness bound to the little rural propriety, which may well be charac-terized as Jacobin. As such, his works reveal an unexpected dimension when analyzed in the context of the agrarian reforms backed by the Revolution between 1789 and 1796

title: Una obra creada para destruir todo lo establecido. La polémica en torno a la publicación de De l’Esprit de Helvétius
summary: Caught between astonishment and indignation, the publication of De L’Espiritin 1758 provoked a political and religious upheaval that directly affected its author, Claude-Adrien Helvétius. The work, originally published with royal approval, soon encountered opposition from a wide spectrum of individuals who saw it as the vanguard of an orchestrated plan to destroy the foundations of society. The scan-dal sparked by this work marked the life of its author, creating opposing reactions towards him among his closest circle and even prompting an alliance between the Jesuits and Jansenists, who were irreconcilable enemies. In the caseDe L’Espirit Ma-dame Helvétius emerged in defense of her husband against attacks from his enemies, who criticized Helvétius’ text for containing a utilitarian morality that was contrary to fanaticism and absolutism

title: Narrative necrosis: temporal disintegration and the crisis of Enlightenment in The Monk — ES: Necrosis narrativa: desintegración temporal y crisis de la Ilustración en el Monk
summary: This article argues that Matthew Lewis’s The Monk does not simply depict crisis but performs it as narrative necrosis, a process in which emplotment decomposes, concordance fails, and teleology stalls. Building a triangulated framework from Paul Ricoeur’s model of emplotment and concordance, Jean-François Lyotard’s account of paralogy, and Derrida’s hauntology, the study defines three diagnostic markers of necrosis: (1) disruption of concordance at the level of plotting and voice, (2) hauntological recurrence that loops time rather than foreshadows it, and (3) anti-teleological sequencing that exhausts closure. Close readings of three pivotal scenes (the Bleeding Nun’s return, Agnes’s entombment, and Ambrosio’s damnation) demonstrate how the novel converts Enlightenment narrative intelligibility into recursive convulsion. The analysis distinguishes recurrence from omen to show why returns in The Monk operate as loops rather than cues toward an ending, and it situates these formal dynamics within late eighteenth-century debates over reason, sensation, and religious authority. By naming and operationalizing narrative necrosis, the article offers a portable analytic that can be applied beyond Gothic fiction to texts in which form registers systemic failure. The result is a revisionary reading of The Monk and a method for tracking how form produces crisis as narrative action.

Construyendo un marco triangulado del modelo de empuje y concordancia de Paul Ricoeur, el relato de paralogía de Jean-François Lyotard, y la embrujada de Derrida, el estudio define tres marcadores diagnósticos de necrosis: (1) perturbación de la concordancia en el nivel de trama y voz, (2) recurrencia embrujada que bucea tiempo en lugar de foreshadows exhaustological cierre, y (3) Las lecturas cercanas de tres escenas pivotales (el regreso de la Nun, la entumecimiento de Agnes y la condenación de Ambrosio) demuestran cómo la novela convierte la inteligibilidad narrativa de la Ilustración en convulsión recursiva. El análisis distingue la recurrencia del omen para mostrar por qué los regresos en El Monk operan como bucles en lugar de cues hacia un final, y sitúa estas dinámicas formales dentro de los debates finales del siglo XVIII sobre la razón, la sensación y la autoridad religiosa. Al nombrar y poner en práctica la necrosis narrativa, el artículo ofrece una analítica portátil que puede aplicarse más allá de la ficción gótica a textos en los que la forma registra falla sistémica. El resultado es una lectura revisionaria del Monk y un método para rastrear cómo la forma produce crisis como acción narrativa.

title: Destino terrible y duro / es al que estoy sentenciado: El pintor fingido, una comedia palatina de tono prerromántico de Vicente Rodríguez de Arellano
summary: In this paper, after reviewing the figure of Vicente Rodríguez de Arellano, a Navarrese writer who lived between the 18th and 19th centuries (and who cultivated nar-rative as well as poetry and theatre), I focus on the analysis of El pintor fingido, a piece premiered in 1799 that was performed quite a few times in the 18th century and also had several editions, which tells us about its considerable success. Generically it is a palatine comedy in the aurisecular style, but a certain pre-romantic tone can be perceived in it, especially in the plane of expression of the melancholic and unhappy temperament of the characters and the force of the «cruel fates», of «adverse luck», etc. After offering the known data of representation and of preserved editions of El pintor fingido, I then analyze what is related to the action, themes, and characters, also adding some notes about the style.

title: Instrumentalización del mito: burguesía y nación en los hermanos Grimm
summary: This article aims to determine whether, through the changes the Brothers Grimm introduced into the content of their tales, these narratives ultimately became instrumen-talized, serving bourgeois pedagogical demands and the emerging idea of the nation. Using a methodology based on the comparative analysis of different versions of three tales from Children’s and Household Tales(«The Virgin Mary’s Child»,«Cinderella», and «Little Brother and Little Sister»), the study identifies elements that operate on three interrelated pedagogical levels: education aimed at establishing a specific model of the family, education for citizenship in the service of the German national project, and reli-gious education. Read in the light of their historical context, these elements reveal a use of the mythical and the magical for educational purposes, which is analyzed here as a pedagogy of the concealment of authority characteristic of the Romantic period
